why: This is a reusable software package for computational auditory analysis, not an instructional element or education-specific research method.
name: R-package for computational modeling of the auditory periphery (ANI, pitch expectation, rhythmical density)
product_description: An R package released by Moura et al. that computes auditory nerve images, pitch images, pitch-expectation profiles, and rhythmical-density measures from audio recordings for music and learning-science research.

why: R-ISAM is a study-specific five-phase curriculum design for integrating anatomical sciences with clinical applications, grounded in existing theories rather than a general theory of learning.
This is a named, study-developed evaluation questionnaire and measurement instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: 65-item R-ISAM evaluation questionnaire with seven domains
product_description: A validated 65-item questionnaire developed by Almasi-Turk Sahar to measure medical students' perceptions of integration, progression, teaching, assessment, learning environment, and satisfaction in an integrated anatomy curriculum.
